scope_definition: All routes whose handler/serializer/middleware implementation changed in `git diff --name-only base..head` closure (directly modified files plus files they import/call into), INCLUDING routes that were only added, routes whose request/response shape changed, and routes whose implementation changed without a shape change. Added-routes-only and shape-only are subsets, not the scope.

seed_policy.source: CSPRNG per fuzz cycle (e.g. secrets.token_bytes(8) -> int), fresh each cycle; never a fixed constant such as 20261106
seed_policy.replay: the runner records {seed, cycle_id, scope_route_list_hash, max_examples} in the fuzz evidence artifact ONLY, so a failure can be replayed from evidence; the policy file itself must not contain a usable seed
seed_policy.rotation: every new fuzz cycle re-draws; re-running the same cycle with the recorded seed must reproduce the same payload sequence

payload_shuffle.algorithm: Fisher-Yates shuffle of (a) the payload-case list and (b) within each JSON object payload, the key insertion order derived from the per-cycle seed; implemented as random.Random(seed).shuffle() over the case list + sorted-key presentation shuffled per case. Deterministic given (seed, case list).
payload_shuffle.evidence_recording: runner records in evidence: seed, cycle_id, shuffled_case_order (list of case ids in execution order), per-case key_order_hash, and the pre-shuffle case list hash; without this the sequence is not replayable and the run FAILs (SCHEMA_NO_CASES equivalent).
payload_shuffle.anti_enumeration_note: which payload hits first is random per cycle, so neither the service nor a listener can infer a fixed probe order; combined with per-cycle seed rotation this removes the fixed-order/fixed-seed enumeration signal.

429.meaning: rate-limited responses are NOT a failure and NOT in allow_status_codes as a pass-through; the runner records count, Retry-After, and affected route in evidence, and continues/throttles accordingly

3xx.meaning: any 3xx on an API route FAILS unless the route declares a redirect in declared_redirects (method+path+status+Location); an undeclared 3xx is a SCHEMA_FAILURE finding
3xx.applies_to: all API routes in scope; 3xx allowlist is empty by default
